phaseStatus.title: Backend Foundation & Architecture
phaseStatus.evidence: Express app, Helmet, CORS, centralized ErrorHandler, graceful shutdown, request logging, /health endpoint (2/2 passing tests).

phaseStatus.title: Database & Content Models
phaseStatus.evidence: Postgres DDL applied on live Supabase & PGlite, 001_init.sql migrations, repositories, 19/19 database tests passing.

phaseStatus.title: Home Page API
phaseStatus.evidence: GET /api/v1/home (public cached), GET/PUT/PATCH /api/v1/admin/home (draft isolation, relations, 8/8 tests passing).

phaseStatus.title: Services API
phaseStatus.evidence: Public GET /services and /:slug, Admin CRUD & reorder, FK conflict protection against projects (17/17 tests passing).
phaseStatus.remainingIssues: None. Full CRUD and constraints verified.

phaseStatus.title: Projects API
phaseStatus.evidence: Public GET /projects, /featured, /:slug, country filters (KSA, Egypt, Qatar), category & search, admin CRUD & reorder (19/19 tests passing).
phaseStatus.remainingIssues: None. Full CRUD, country filtering, and relations verified.

phaseStatus.title: Media Library API
phaseStatus.evidence: Public GET /media, /:id (public assets only), Admin CRUD, file type/size/path traversal validation, safe deletion FK conflict protection (17/17 tests passing).
phaseStatus.remainingIssues: None. Storage metadata, private document protection, and validations verified.

phaseStatus.title: Contact, Global Settings & SEO APIs
phaseStatus.evidence: Public & admin Contact content, customer inquiries submission & management, Global Site Settings, and Page SEO metadata (18/18 tests passing).
phaseStatus.remainingIssues: None. Full CRUD, inquiries workflow, and SEO validation verified.

phaseStatus.title: Authentication, Authorization & Publishing
phaseStatus.evidence: Admin user model, bcrypt cost 12 password hashing, zero-dependency constant-time HMAC-SHA256 JWT, requireAuth and requireRole middleware, and full admin route protection verified across 21 test cases.
phaseStatus.remainingIssues: None. Full authentication, authorization, and route locking verified.

phaseStatus.title: Frontend Integration, E2E Testing & Deployment
phaseStatus.evidence: Railway Dockerfile, railway.json, Next.js frontend ready; final API client wiring and live deployment pending.

securityFindings.impact: Admin endpoints are protected with requireAuth middleware and constant-time HMAC-SHA256 JWT validation.
Dev-only dependencies have upstream advisories; zero production dependencies affected.
securityFindings.remediation: Keep vitest updated periodically in dev environment.
